lineage.note: Humboldt CSI's official F1 Durb S1 page lists F1 Durb × F1 Durb. Together with the official S1 designation, this is treated as a selfed S1 line; no additional ancestry is inferred.

aromas.note: The official F1 Durb S1 page does not provide bounded cultivar-wide aroma descriptors for the complete S1 line.

terpenes.note: The official F1 Durb S1 page does not provide a cultivar-specific lot terpene profile or COA for the S1 line.

origin.note: The official F1 Durb S1 page identifies the source cut context but does not state the S1 line's exact creation location; no location is inferred.

history.note: The official page notes limited seed production from a reversal using Cookie Monster's F1 Durb cut, but no sufficiently bounded release chronology is asserted for this atlas entry.
